objective: Publish at least two evidence-led BLRO practical insights every calendar day without exposing unapproved vendor, customer, pricing, or security-sensitive claims.

cadence.daily: Two public candidates and one reserve draft
cadence.weekly: Fourteen published insights, seven reserve drafts, and one portfolio review
cadence.review_sla: Research completes before the publication day; technical and publication approval complete before public status

tasks.title: Create a research intake and evidence ledger
acceptanceCriteria: Each candidate has a question, audience, source URLs, access date, claim notes, reviewer, and public-status decision.
Vendor comparison, pricing, compatibility, incident, and customer data are classified before drafting.

tasks.title: Define daily topic lanes and a four-week editorial backlog
acceptanceCriteria: Every business day has two named topics plus a reserve.
The first four weeks prioritize security consulting, infrastructure consulting, virtualization/HCI migration, and VMware-Nutanix evaluation questions.

tasks.title: Run the daily deep-research and drafting workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Each draft uses at least two primary sources or one primary source plus a clearly labelled field-practice source.
Each insight states decision context, scope, exclusions, evidence date, and linked BLRO service.

tasks.title: Add a publish gate and enforce draft isolation
acceptanceCriteria: Only reviewed and approved MDX enters the public index.
VMware-Nutanix comparisons stay draft until source, legal, and publication review are complete.

tasks.title: Measure and improve the content system weekly
acceptanceCriteria: Weekly report records published count, backlog, review age, source quality, corrections, and CTA engagement.
Topics with weak evidence or no practical decision value are retired or rewritten.
